messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: P1 - multiple node NotReady events in inference-pool-us-east-1. Incident INC-20260315-42. Paging oncall team.

alex_m: taking the pager, I'm online. pulling up cluster and infra dashboards.

sana: on standup but can jump in. saw kubelet restarts in that pool ~10:02 UTC earlier.

alex_m: running quick node list -
```
$ kubectl get nodes -l pool=inference-us-east-1 -o wide
NAME             STATUS     ROLES    AGE   VERSION
node-ig-24xx     NotReady   <none>   12d   v1.25.8
node-ig-24xy     Ready      <none>   14d   v1.25.8
node-ig-24xz     NotReady   <none>   7d    v1.25.8
```

alex_m: NotReady on 2/3 nodes in pool. checking events on node-ig-24xx.

jamal: also seeing elevated 5xx rates from inference-router in us-east-1 - likely capacity + restarts.

infra-bot: Prometheus alert: node_kubelet_running_pod_count_increase (node-ig-24xx) at 2026-03-15T10:05:12Z.

alex_m: fetching kubelet journal on node-ig-24xx via ssh (masking IP) -
```
Mar 15 10:03:47 node-ig-24xx kubelet[1234]: E0315 10:03:47.123456 kubelet.go:214] Runtime service error: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = containerd: unexpected EOF
Mar 15 10:03:48 node-ig-24xx systemd[1]: kubelet.service: Main process exited, code=exited, status=137/killed
Mar 15 10:03:48 node-ig-24xx systemd[1]: kubelet.service: Failed with result 'signal'.
Mar 15 10:03:50 node-ig-24xx kubelet[2045]: Kubelet started.
Mar 15 10:04:01 node-ig-24xx kubelet[2045]: Node not ready: eviction threshold reached: memory.available < 100Mi
```

alex_m: looks like kubelet got killed (OOM signal) and then node reported eviction pressure. probable kernel oom or container runtime crash.

eva: any GPU errors in dmesg? these are G4s with mixed workloads.

alex_m: grabbing dmesg tail -
```
[ 12345.678901] Out of memory: Kill process 98765 (runtime) score 987 or sacrifice child
[ 12345.679012] Killed process 98765 (containerd-shim) total-vm:xxxxxxxk, anon-rss:yyyyyyk
[ 12345.679123] NVRM: GPU restart required due to GPU page fault
```

jamal: hmm gpu page fault + oom on kubelet. could be a kernel driver hiccup repeatedly killing container runtime which brings kubelet down -> node flips NotReady.

sana: for immediate mitigation we should cordon node-ig-24xx and move pods off the flapping node to prevent evictions from affecting running inference traffic. also scale up the pool replacement nodes.

alex_m: doing cordon/drain on node-ig-24xx (evictions respect pod disruption budgets)
```
$ kubectl cordon node-ig-24xx
node/node-ig-24xx cordoned
$ kubectl drain node-ig-24xx --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

infra-bot: Autoscaler triggered: launching a replacement instance: node-ig-25aa. expected ready in ~3m.

cs-rep: CS alert: a handful of customers reported increased latency and intermittent 500s to embeddings endpoint in us-east. currently ~2% request error rate above baseline.

alex_m: noted. setting customer impact: degraded for embeddings and generation in us-east-1. posting to status page draft.

jamal: we should also check if a recent kernel or driver rollout happened on those nodes. deploy-bot any recent infra ops playbooks?

deploy-bot: No kernel/driver updates recorded in the last 24h for autoscaling group inference-pool-us-east-1. Last change: scaling policy tweak 3 days ago.

sana: can we grep cloud-init logs for containerd restarts? maybe image or resource spike?

alex_m: pulling container logs from one of the restarted runtime pods -
```
E0315 09:59:22.123 kubelet: containerd: failed to allocate device memory: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
E0315 09:59:22.125 containerd: failed to start container: exit status 1
```

eva: that suggests some inference jobs tried to exceed GPU memory and leaked? but kernel-level OOM also present. could be hardware fault on node-ig-24xx GPU.

alex_m: mitigation plan executed: cordoned node, drained live, autoscaler spinning replacement. i'll leave node-ig-24xx cordoned and tainted with maintenance=true:NoSchedule.

alex_m: applying taint -
```
kubectl taint nodes node-ig-24xx maintenance=true:NoSchedule --overwrite
```

jamal: rolling traffic over: switching subset of inference-router to us-west and eu nodes temporarily via routing policy. should cut customer error rate.

cs-rep: confirmed some customers no longer seeing errors after routing change. sending proactive notifications.

alex_m: next steps: 1) run a hardware diagnostic on node-ig-24xx (GPU and memory), 2) keep node cordoned, 3) let autoscaler provision and uncordon replacement nodes once healthy. I'll escalate to infra hardware team if diagnostics show GPU fault.

sana: i'll run a quick image and runtime sanity check across remaining pool nodes to ensure no drift.

eva: tagging this incident for postmortem: likely cause = hardware (GPU) + container-runtime OOM leading to kubelet restarts and node NotReady flips causing pod churn and customer impact.

alex_m: handing off to jamal for 10:30-11:30 UTC oncall window. jamal - summary: cordoned node-ig-24xx, tainted maintenance, drained pods, autoscaler creating replacement, routing fallback applied, customer impact degraded briefly, diagnostics pending.

jamal: taking over. I'll follow up with infra/hardware and update incident timeline. please DM if anything urgent.

incident-bot: Incident update recorded. Current status: mitigation in progress, customer impact degraded -> partial. Incident owner: jamal.

jamal: closing the pager for now but keeping the incident open until replacement node healthy and diagnostics complete. will post full timeline afterward.
